name: Credo Brands Marketing Limited
summary: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd. is a retailer of men's casual apparel in India, best known for its MUFTI brand. Its collection spans shirts, t-shirts, pants, sweatshirts, denim, chinos, jackets, blazers and sweaters, for everyday, urban, party and athleisure styles. Founded in 1998, it is based in Mumbai.
